summary: Action required: Pod network subnet exhaustion
description: Your cluster requires you to take action because the pod network CIDR ${CLUSTER_NETWORK_CIDR} with a host prefix of /${HOST_PREFIX} only supports ${MAX_NODES} nodes, but your cluster currently has ${CURRENT_NODES} nodes, exceeding this limit. New nodes cannot be allocated a pod subnet and will fail to become schedulable. Please reduce your node count to ${MAX_NODES} or fewer, or recreate your cluster with a larger pod network CIDR. Without action, your cluster's SLA may be impacted, along with your ability to scale and upgrade. Please refer to this documentation for more information: https://docs.openshift.com/rosa/rosa_planning/rosa-limits-scalability.html.
